title: M-PSK Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using M-ary phase shift keying, 1 input, 1 output, {Constellation ordering} sets Symbol mapping; {M-ary number} sets the modulation order of the PSK constellation, {Input type} sets the type of input, {Constellation mapping} sets the user-defined symbol mapping, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase offset, {View constellation} sets the option to plot reference constellation and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: Modulation order of the PSK constellation 8 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input type
params.values: Type of input signal Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase offset in radians pi/8 (default) | scalar

params.name: View constellation
params.values: Option to plot reference constellation button

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | Inherit via back propagation | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) |
